## Games available on the platform
games:
  - name: Wavelength
    description: A telepathic party game where players guess positions on a spectrum based on one-word clues. Perfect for discovering how well you and your partner think alike!
    players: 2-20
    modes: Classic (2P for couples), Party (2-6P teams)
    best-for: Couples, friends, parties
  - name: Rapid Fire - This or That
    description: Quick 10-second choices between two options. Score points when you match with your partner! Great for LDR couples.
    players: 2
    categories: Food, Movies, Lifestyle, Relationships, Fun, Spicy, Lust, Work, Health, Hot Takes
    best-for: Couples, LDR, quick dates
  - name: Red Flag Green Flag
    description: Rate dating behaviors as red flags, green flags, or beige flags. See if you and your partner agree on relationship standards!
    players: 2
    features: Limited beige flags force hard choices, varying game lengths (20/50/100 rounds)
    best-for: Couples, dating, relationship discussions
  - name: General Knowledge
    description: Test your smarts with quick rapid-fire trivia across 15 different topics like History, Pop Culture, Movies, Music, Science, and more.
    players: 2-6
    best-for: Friends, groups, trivia lovers
  - name: Fantasy Slider
    description: Rate your interest in various fantasies and bucket list items on a scale of 0-10. See how well matched you are!
    players: 2
    best-for: Couples, intimate dates, relationship building
  - name: Who's Most Likely
    description: Point fingers! Who is most likely to do what? You only have 10 seconds to decide.
    players: 2
    best-for: Couples, friends, parties

## How the main Wavelength game works
wavelength-gameplay:
  - One player becomes the Psychic and sees a hidden target on a spectrum
  - The spectrum has two opposing concepts (e.g., "Hot" vs "Cold")
  - The Psychic gives a one-word clue suggesting where the target is
  - Other players guess the position based on the clue
  - Points awarded based on accuracy: 4 (bullseye), 3 (close), 2 (near), 0 (miss)

## How mini games work
mini-games-gameplay:
  this-or-that:
    - Both players see two options (e.g., "Beach vacation" vs "Mountain trip")
    - 10 seconds to choose
    - Score a point when both players pick the same answer
  red-flag-green-flag:
    - Both players see a dating behavior scenario
    - Choose: Red Flag (dealbreaker), Green Flag (love it), or Beige Flag (meh)
    - Limited beige flags per game forces decisive choices
    - Score points when both pick the same flag (Red+Red, Green+Green, or Beige+Beige)
